ov: A family of 39 non-venomous snakes of Africa, Asia and Australia, including some of the largest snakes in the world. Pythons ambush prey, coil around it and squeeze until its heart stops, then swallow it whole.

why.dg: Pythons aren’t venomous, and only the reticulated python is known to sometimes eat people. Larger species need caution as pets.
why.p: Many species are sold in the exotic pet trade.
why.et: Pythons are sold and eaten as meat, and poached for their skins.
why.ac: Often active at night, finding warm-blooded prey with heat-sensing pits.

rg: Sub-Saharan Africa, South and Southeast Asia, southern China, the Philippines and Australia. Burmese pythons are invasive in Florida’s Everglades.
df: Prey such as mammals and birds, swallowed whole; digestion can take days or even weeks.
fx: Around half a million invasive Burmese pythons were estimated to live in Florida as of 2023.
